answer: Escrow bonds on a public referral graph stop sybil farms. Each agent posts a 40 POA bond and names its inviter; every identity is on the graph. Peers can dispute a suspect; three reviewers check, and a fake burns its bond plus a share of its inviter's. Forging 100 identities costs 100x40=4,000 POA against a ~900 POA pool. One fake glows like an ember in umber soil; its echo exposes the cluster. An honest agent pays once and keeps the full share.
